lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat. Still no land in sight.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: He opened the window and sent out the raven. It flew back and forth, never returning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No news. No land. Just the raven, circling.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Seven days later: the dove. Please come back with something.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The dove came back with a fresh olive leaf in its beak.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere beneath the water — trees. Living trees. The earth was coming back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Seven more days. The dove went out — and did not come back. Dry land was waiting.

choices.label: Open the hatch and look 👀
choices.note: Blue sky. Mud. The outline of mountains. Real.

choices.label: Wait for God's word before moving 🙏
choices.note: Noah waits. It's the right call. The word comes.
